author: Liername45
quote: After 13 years of waiting, GTA 6 is a massive disappointment. The hype was completely undeserved. The story feels lazy and uninspired, the dual protagonists are boring, and the missions are just the same old formula recycled from GTA 5 with almost no innovation. The open world looks pretty in screenshots, but once you actually play it, the map feels empty and the AI is still as dumb as ever. Performance is also mediocre for a next-gen exclusive, with frequent stutters and weird physics glitches. Rockstar clearly prioritized marketing over making a truly great game. Save your money.
